description: Use this skill when a user asks to inspect Harbor projects, repositories, artifacts, scans, vulnerabilities, quotas, GC, replication or retention, or to start an artifact scan, create a tag or delete one mutable tag. For Docker hosts and Portainer use container-host-aiops; for Kubernetes cluster resources use k8s-aiops.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
Did the agent verify final system state with concrete evidence?
